newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open slightly firmer.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open slightly firmer.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were called to open slightly firmer on Thursday, and although LME three months contract was barely changed in overnight dealings, the backwardation firmed $10 to $15 from late Wednesday to underpin prices further, dealers said.
COMEX July copper was called to open 0.20 to 0.30 cent a lb firmer from Wednesday's close at 121.95 cents, after trading in a 122.50-121.35 cent range in overnight ACCESS trade.
LME copper stocks rose 825 tonnes Thursday to 123,350 tonnes. COMEX stocks on Wednesday were unchanged at 48,961 short tons.
